rows.title: Best Chef
rows.blurb: The brass bell rings. Floodlights swing over the canopy: BEST CHEF.

rows.title: Crawler Cookery 101
rows.blurb: Crumb's whiteboard: MEAT. VEG.

rows.title: Lost Property Bin
rows.blurb: A plastic LOST PROPERTY bin under the arrival bench, spilling cheap props: a steak knife still tagged PROP, and a mop somebody marked MINE.

rows.title: The Chef's Lift
rows.blurb: A brass service lift behind the podium, its gate stencilled CHEF ONLY.

rows.title: The Way Down
rows.blurb: Three ways off the platform. A rope bridge strung with fairy lights, crumbs on every plank.

rows.title: Raptor Tracks
rows.blurb: Three-toed prints in the mud, circling the lichen heap.

rows.title: The Eel River
rows.blurb: A brown river along one side of the clearing, warm as a bath and crackling.

rows.title: The Five
rows.blurb: Five wrong shapes in the ferns, just past the light line from the clearing.

rows.title: The Honey Hive
rows.blurb: A hive the size of a house hangs over the clearing from one thick branch, humming.

rows.title: The Lichen Heap
rows.blurb: A mound of grey-green lichen at the foot of the vine slide, soft and deep, and shaped by everyone who has landed on it.

rows.title: The Talent Arrows
rows.blurb: Two arrows in gaffer tape on the wet rock. One is fresh.

rows.title: The Yam Patch
rows.blurb: Broad leaves in the warm ground off the edge of the heap.

rows.title: Mayor Snap's Procession
rows.blurb: The Mayor sits in a wheelbarrow outside the town hall in her chain of office, crumbling.

rows.title: The Bitten Merlon
rows.blurb: High on the gate wall, a bite. Gingerbread bricks gone.

rows.title: The Bridge Gantry
rows.blurb: The rope bridge from the canopy lands on a crew gantry bolted to the gate wall.

rows.title: The Crumb Pension
rows.blurb: A row of benches in the sun outside the bakery.

rows.title: The Meat Guest Room
rows.blurb: A cottage on the corner. The family insists.

rows.title: The Missing Bite
rows.blurb: The baker's wife sits on the edge of the fountain with a crescent bitten out of her shoulder, sobbing into her apron.

rows.title: The Rain Bell
rows.blurb: A stagehand with a clipboard and a headset stands beside the brass bell, checking his watch.

rows.title: Saffron's Pitch
rows.blurb: One episode. The finale of SURVIVAL CHEF: INTO THE DARK.

rows.title: Saffron's Prep Table
rows.blurb: She cooks with her back to the water and never looks round.

rows.title: The Empty Chairs
rows.blurb: Six canvas director's chairs in a row, facing the water.

rows.title: The Lanyard Hook
rows.blurb: A tent peg hammered into the rock behind the chairs, with eleven crew lanyards on it.

rows.title: The Mopped Trail
rows.blurb: A smear on the white shingle, wide as a cart, from the water's edge to the chairs and back.

rows.title: The Rushes Monitor
rows.blurb: In the back of her tent, a battered laptop on an equipment case, battery at four percent.

rows.title: Krakaren Carcass
rows.blurb: The Great White's first body, folded on the shingle where it fell, already splitting.

rows.title: The ACTION Loop
rows.blurb: A crew walkie on a dead assistant director's chest, taped to TALK, looping his last call.

rows.title: The Black Water
rows.blurb: A pool of black water the width of the set, lit from above.

rows.title: The Camera Jib
rows.blurb: A camera crane leaning out over the pool, its camera still recording on the end of the arm, the counterweight swinging.

rows.title: The Dead Crew
rows.blurb: The crew are still at their posts: a woman holding a boom up over nothing, a focus puller on an apple box, a grip under a sandbag.

rows.title: The Hanging Truss
rows.blurb: A lighting truss hung from one chain over the middle of the pool, the other chain snapped.

rows.title: The Lamp Board
rows.blurb: A lighting desk on a flight case, a man in headphones slumped over the faders.

rows.title: The Live Cable
rows.blurb: A fat, sparking power cable lying an arm's length from the water.

rows.title: The Props Tent
rows.blurb: A collapsed tent of crates marked PROPS. Rubber knives, foam rocks, a fire extinguisher made of cardboard, a fake severed hand.

rows.title: The Abandoned Nest
rows.blurb: The matriarch's nest by the crashed chopper is abandoned.

rows.title: The Capture Cage
rows.blurb: A crew capture cage for the nature segment: steel bars, a drop gate on a rope, big enough for a horse.

rows.title: The Clutch
rows.blurb: In the chopper's cabin, a nest of fern, foam and headsets, and in it a clutch of speckled eggs the size of footballs, warm to the touch.

rows.title: The Floodlight Timer
rows.blurb: Six floodlights strapped to a tree, wired to a grey timer box at its foot.

rows.title: The Nature Segment
rows.blurb: A camera on a tripod, still recording, and three dead crew in the ferns around it.

rows.title: The Sponsor Drop
rows.blurb: Mid-fight, a jingle plays from nowhere and a crate floats down on a striped parachute into the middle of the clearing: SCORCH!

rows.title: The Birdcage
rows.blurb: A gilded birdcage the size of a wardrobe, a velvet cushion on the floor, crumbs everywhere.

rows.title: The Bone Bargain
rows.blurb: Four little saucers beside the teapot. Mother Treacle taps each with a silver teaspoon.

rows.title: The Dough Trough
rows.blurb: A long wooden trough under a damp cloth, heaving gently.

rows.title: The Forbidden Shelf
rows.blurb: A high shelf over the counter, out of camera, behind a curtain: jars with handwritten labels and one fat cookbook, its spine cracked.

rows.title: The Good Oven
rows.blurb: A black iron range at the back of the set, the oven door big enough to walk into, orange light round its edges.

rows.title: The Studio Audience
rows.blurb: Bleachers in the dark behind the cameras, and on them rows of pale, unbaked gingerbread folk, sitting very still.

rows.title: The Tape Shelf
rows.blurb: A row of VHS tapes in cracked cases, hand-labelled: TREACLE'S KITCHEN, series one to six.

rows.title: The Tasting
rows.blurb: The counter, laid for tea under the dead cameras: a tiered stand of treacle tart, cream horns, sticky toffee, a pot of something brown and sweet.

rows.title: Calls Service
rows.blurb: A silver glass bell beside the judge's chair.

rows.title: Loading Dock Forklift
rows.blurb: A yellow stadium forklift with a sponsor wrap, a flashing amber beacon and a seat sticker reading OPERATOR MUST BE CERTIFIED (NOBODY IS).

rows.title: The Cloche
rows.blurb: A silver dome the size of a house hangs over the dais on four chains.

rows.title: The Frozen Vault Door
rows.blurb: Rime rims a blank steel recess behind the loading-dock dumpsters.

rows.title: The Kill Floor
rows.blurb: The stadium floor splits open onto conveyor lanes, fryer vats and laser emitters.

rows.title: The Mystery Basket
rows.blurb: At a service gong, two wicker baskets float down from the stadium roof on striped parachutes, one to each kitchen, lids strapped shut.

rows.title: The Pantry Wall
rows.blurb: A wall of glass lockers under the scoreboard, one per kitchen.

rows.title: The Prize Placard
rows.blurb: Five brass plates sit under the scoreboard: 15, 25, 40, 55, 65.

rows.title: The Restock Ledger
rows.blurb: An usher changes the date with a wooden slider.

rows.title: The Rival Kitchen
rows.blurb: The other kitchen, ten paces across the dais: the same steel, the same knives, and tonight's opponent's name in lights over it.

rows.title: The Scoreboard
rows.blurb: A scoreboard the size of a house in the trees over the stadium, a bulb for every digit, two kitchen names in lights.

rows.title: The Usher Alarm
rows.blurb: A red beacon over the pass, dark for now, wired to every usher's radio.

rows.title: Gallery Suppression
rows.blurb: Every gallery has a red lever beneath a sprinkler head.

rows.title: Preserving Cloches
rows.blurb: Steel retaining collars secure the glass covers.

rows.title: The Brass Bell
rows.blurb: A brass bell on the attendant desk. Folded menu napkins stand in every gallery.

rows.title: The Cellar Archive
rows.blurb: The service lift stops at a glass-covered latch below the walk-in.

rows.title: The Founder's Plate
rows.blurb: At the Pass, a photograph of an old chef holding a steaming bowl, beside a cooking method engraved in steel.

rows.title: The Sorbet Gallery
rows.blurb: Eight numbered dishes under green glass, each containing four scoops.

rows.title: The Tasting Pot
rows.blurb: An induction pan with a porcelain crawler standing inside.

rows.title: Rent-a-Snout
rows.blurb: A leather lead hangs from a trolley beside an open biscuit tin.

rows.title: The Fairy Ring
rows.blurb: In an alcove off the entrance ledge, a perfect ring of mushrooms glows violet, green, blue and gold.

rows.title: The Mushroom Shelves
rows.blurb: Brown shelves climb the walls above yellow puffballs and red cups.

rows.title: The Puffball Lanes
rows.blurb: Three straight furrows cross the cave between yellow puffballs.

rows.title: The Sow's Carcass
rows.blurb: A split, fungal-armored sow with a red-veined lump pulsing beneath the breastbone.

rows.title: The Truffle Beds
rows.blurb: Two patches of loose black soil beneath the mushroom shelves are covered in little hoofprints.

rows.title: Dinner Bell Vapour
rows.blurb: The smell changes from warm sugar and garlic to a fresh meal.

rows.title: Qualifier Stock
rows.blurb: A steel crate stencilled STOCK: CHECK MANIFEST.

rows.title: The Audit Basket
rows.blurb: A dot-matrix printer feeds curling paper into a wire cage.

rows.title: The Dry Ice Machine
rows.blurb: A battered machine says DRY ICE. Its empty water tank has a sight glass; below it, a steel trolley holds folded insulated sacks.

rows.title: The Season Selector
rows.blurb: Four brass selectors point to numbered pens.

rows.title: The Grease Trap Hatch
rows.blurb: A wall tile behind the grease trap, cleaner than its neighbours, with a chalk mammoth drawn on it.

rows.title: The Hungry Disposal
rows.blurb: A silver spoon lies below steel teeth.

rows.title: The Judges' Returns
rows.blurb: Three returned plates wait beside the scraper.

rows.title: The Scullery Manifold
rows.blurb: TAP shows a blue cup.

rows.title: Three Dirty Trays
rows.blurb: A brush, tongs and thick gloves hang between the three sinks.

rows.title: The Crystal Seam
rows.blurb: Three fist-sized crystal clusters glitter beside the pool.

rows.title: The Pool Wheel
rows.blurb: A red wheel behind the crocodile's tail. Three grooves run from its pipe to empty basins.

rows.title: The Quiet Mudbank
rows.blurb: The salt channel is still. The Brinejaw's bib floats on the brine, and gulls pick at the mudbank where it used to bask.

rows.title: The Soft Terraces
rows.blurb: Deep hoofprints fill with grey brine. Cracks divide the white ledges; a fallen branch bridges one wet patch.

rows.title: The Dinner Wheel
rows.blurb: Three brass rings surround the strapped volunteer.

rows.title: The Glazed Walls
rows.blurb: The inside of the trunk is ribbed with comb, glazed amber from the floor to as high as you can see.

rows.title: The Wax Door
rows.blurb: A wall of soft amber wax seals the trunk from side to side.

rows.title: The Brood Cells
rows.blurb: Six-sided cells, floor to ceiling, each holding a fat white grub.

rows.title: The Hornet Breach
rows.blurb: A ragged hole chewed through the brood wall halfway down the gallery, daylight showing through it, wax crumbs on the floor.

rows.title: The Capped Ceiling
rows.blurb: A ceiling of capped wax cells over Dolly's head.

rows.title: The Drone Run
rows.blurb: A narrow drain channel behind the vats, slick with old venom, climbing steeply into the dark.

rows.title: The Venom Vats
rows.blurb: Wax vats as big as bathtubs line the walls, brimming with clear venom that smokes where it drips.

rows.title: The Empty Brood Chamber
rows.blurb: The throne comb is cooling. Workers wander without orders, and wax drips from the ceiling.

rows.title: The Honey Pool
rows.blurb: The chamber floor is flooded knee-deep with warm honey.

rows.title: The Royal Cell
rows.blurb: One cell behind the throne glows pale, like a nightlight, brimming with something that wobbles.

rows.title: Field Handling
rows.blurb: A chalk beast wears a net, a harness and an expression of deep personal betrayal.

rows.title: The Bone Stall
rows.blurb: A workbench lashed between two trunks, scarred with knife marks: a vice made from a turtle's jaw, pots of glue, coils of gut, and Tamarind's eldest.

rows.title: The Rope Bridges
rows.blurb: Sagging rope bridges between trunks the width of houses, planks missing, a hundred feet of air under them.

rows.title: The Stalls
rows.blurb: Bamboo platforms lashed to the trunks like shelves, each one a stall: spears stacked like umbrellas, turtle-shell shields, wicker armour hung on pegs.

rows.title: The Stash Nest
rows.blurb: A ball of woven leaves high in the tallest trunk, glinting with things that do not grow on trees.

rows.title: The Wine Gourds
rows.blurb: Gourds as big as barrels hang in a cluster from one branch, fizzing, a few of them leaking something cloudy and sweet.

rows.title: The Empty Lodge
rows.blurb: The rail of hams swings in a draught that used to be a breath.

rows.title: The Hanging Rail
rows.blurb: A long iron rail under the rafters, hung with half-cured monsters on hooks: haunches, hocks, things with too many legs.

rows.title: The Roof Vents
rows.blurb: Three soot-black shutters in what's left of the roof, all closed, reached by a slope of fallen beams.

rows.title: The Smoke Pit
rows.blurb: A wide pit of glowing hickory in the middle of the floor, banked high, pouring smoke into the room.

rows.title: The Talking Trophy
rows.blurb: A man's head mounted on a varnished plaque above the door, cured to leather, beard and all.

rows.title: The Warm Rock
rows.blurb: A boulder at the back of the cold smoker, warm to the touch, with no fire anywhere near it.

rows.title: The Gourd Clock
rows.blurb: Pumpkins hang all over the plant, five of them, green going orange.

rows.title: The Quiet Pit
rows.blurb: Vines hang slack. Pumpkin bombs sit unexploded in the loam, and a wrapped bundle is wedged in the roots.

rows.title: The Rope Drop
rows.blurb: A frayed rope hangs from the canopy forty feet up, swinging.

rows.title: The Strangler Vines
rows.blurb: Strangler vines thick as arms climb every wall of the sinkhole to a ring of daylight forty feet up.

rows.title: Tell the Hunt
rows.blurb: Ochre pats the bare stone at the end of the wall, taps her own chest, then points at you.

rows.title: The First Fire
rows.blurb: A fire in a ring of stones so old the stones have glazed, banked with bone.

rows.title: The Guest of Honour
rows.blurb: A tall, very old man in a black chef's jacket, trussed to a green pole over the coals like a fish, conscious and furious.

rows.title: The Hunting Wall
rows.blurb: The back wall, floor to ceiling, in red ochre and charcoal: every beast on this floor, running.

rows.title: The Cobble Prints
rows.blurb: Three-toed prints pressed into the icing of the cobbles, one line of them, still sharp in the sugar.

rows.title: The Hotel Pan
rows.blurb: One hotel pan still clipped shut in the torn cooler.

rows.title: The Picker's Basket
rows.blurb: A basket on the stile. Brown shelves, red cups, and a sugar-scrawled slate: ASK BEFORE YOU EAT.

rows.title: Pearl's Drag
rows.blurb: A cigarette in a tentacle-shaped ring, still burning, left on a crate by the WASH UP stair.

rows.title: The Backstage Service Rail
rows.blurb: Three cards hang on the rail: BURNT, LOOSE, COLD.

rows.title: The Velvet Rope
rows.blurb: A gingerbread usher in an undone red coat holds a velvet rope across the stair up into the floodlights.

rows.title: The Fitting Chair
rows.blurb: One wooden chair under the bulb, a tape measure hung on the back.

rows.title: The Cold Vent
rows.blurb: A rusted grille at ankle height, breathing cold air.

rows.title: The Far Door
rows.blurb: A plain wooden door with a brass plate reading TUTORIAL EXIT.

rows.title: The Loose Flagstone
rows.blurb: A flagstone that rocks, just slightly, when stepped on.

rows.title: The New Mortar
rows.blurb: A patch of wall with soft, new mortar and a seam shaped like a lever slot.

options.label: Saw The Mortar With The Trip Wire

rows.title: The Tripwire
rows.blurb: A hair-thin wire stretched across the corridor at shin height.

rows.title: The Whispering Wall
rows.blurb: The far wall, where a voice keeps asking what time it is.

rows.title: Mott's Cell
rows.blurb: A barred cell door, locked from the corridor side.

rows.title: The Giant Snail
rows.blurb: A shell the size of a car, and a slime trail you could skate on.
